reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the confusion this has caused with your time entries.

A 5-hour offset usually points to a timezone mismatch between your mobile device and your Loopwise account settings — this can happen if your phone's timezone was set differently at the time you logged the entry (for example, while traveling), or if your account's default timezone doesn't match your device's local timezone.

Could you help me narrow this down by sharing the following?

1. What timezone is currently set in your Loopwise account (Settings > Profile > Timezone)?
2. What timezone is your mobile device set to?
3. A couple of examples of affected entries (the time shown vs. the time you actually logged it), along with the dates.
4. Which mobile app version and OS (iOS/Android) you're using.

In the meantime, if you notice this happening in real time, checking that your device's timezone (usually under Settings > General > Date & Time) is set to "Set Automatically" can sometimes resolve it going forward.

Once I have those details, I'll dig into your account and get this corrected.

Thanks for your patience!

Best,
Loopwise Support
